email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Media & Communication trainee position at ICF Next in Brussels. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content creation, and social media, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to large-scale EU campaigns and grow my skills in PR, influencer marketing, and advertising.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites. I also run mirook.com, where I've implemented structured data and social media integration, and I regularly monitor performance using tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush. My background includes front-end development, which gives me a technical edge in digital communication.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and have a valid Belgian residency. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a B1 level in Dutch and a willingness to learn French. I am eager to bring my storytelling, organizational skills, and proactive attitude to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to ICF Next.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Media & Communication trainee position at ICF Next in Brussels. With a solid foundation in digital marketing, content creation, and social media, I am eager to apply my skills to support your team in delivering impactful communication campaigns for European institutions.

Currently, as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO for client websites, write keyword-targeted blog content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. This role has honed my ability to create engaging content and optimize it for search engines, skills that are directly transferable to social media and PR activities. I am also the creator of mirook.com, a project where I designed and built a multi-page website for a Belgian youth chess champion. There, I implemented structured data (JSON-LD), entity optimization, and social media integration, and I continuously monitor performance using tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush. This hands-on experience has taught me the importance of data-driven decisions and attention to detail.

My technical background includes front-end development, which gives me a unique perspective on digital communication. I am proficient in Microsoft Office tools and comfortable with various content management systems. I am a proactive problem-solver who thrives in team environments and is always eager to learn.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and have residency in Belgium. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a B1 level in Dutch and a willingness to improve my French. I am particularly excited about the opportunity to work on European projects and to contribute to campaigns that have a real impact.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm align with the goals of ICF Next.

Sincerely,
